verdict.rationale: Sill is a Mac-to-iPhone/iPad screen-streaming and remote-control app, not an agent itself, so offering an official MCP server is a fair question for this kind of tool. Nothing in the evidence mentions MCP or any agent integration. The probes found no llms.txt and no OpenAPI spec, so the axis applies but is unsupported.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
